content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Events Health Check Tab ## slug: events-admin-tab-health-check ## seoTitle: Events Health Check Tab ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ![Events%20Admin%20Tab_Events%20Health%20Check_v2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Events%20Admin%20Tab_Events%20Health%20Check_v2.png){height="" width=""} The Events Health Check tab lists the packaged version number, the authorized user, and other access variables. This page is helpful when troubleshooting errors. * Vanity Domain: use if you have a custom domain defined. * Has license assigned: indicates if your authorized user has an assigned Blackthorn license. * Is event admin: indicates if your authorized user has the {{variable.PS_ET_Admin}} permission set. * Object permissions: indicates if the authorized user has access to all Blackthorn Events objects.
